title: Resilient regional routing and fallback layer for embeddings reranking
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: harden the embeddings->rerank execution path so production reranking scales across regions with predictable latency and graceful degradation. This ticket implements timeouts, per-model and per-region circuit breakers, a multi-tier fallback policy (cheaper quantized model -> CPU fallback -> stale cached rank list), and routing rules that prefer local region capacity but will failover with minimal added latency. Deliverables: 1) routing policy engine updates, 2) pluggable circuit breaker library with health signals, 3) fallback policy definitions and runtime, 4) tests and chaos experiments, 5) dashboards and SLO alerts.
updates: 2026-02-20: Initial discovery — measured tail latencies for rerank pipeline across regions using production traces (10k requests). Found 99th pct spikes correlated with large batch KV-cache misses and model hot-swapping events.
2026-02-24: Design sync with PM and SRE. Agreed on target SLOs: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms for single-region rerank (median document count 12). When failing over cross-region, p95 < 220ms, p99 < 600ms.

2026-02-28: Implemented prototype circuit breaker using token-bucket error thresholds + rolling 30s window. Prototype lives in feature branch feat/rerank-cb. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3127
2026-03-02: Added fallback policy DSL to runtime config: order= [primary-model, quantized-model, cpu-model, cache-stale]. Confirmed integration tests for policy enforcement.

2026-03-05: Load test (k6) showed stable p99 at 320ms for regional routing with 2x baseline QPS. Observed increased error rate when primary region GPU pool is at 85% utilization; circuit breaker trips as expected and route shifts to secondary region with average penalty of 58ms.

2026-03-06: Security reviewed edge cases for data residency with Legal — fallback to cross-region routing marked as requiring tenant opt-in. Updated config to support tenant-level routing preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Unit and integration tests covering timeouts, circuit breaker tripping/untripping, and each fallback path
End-to-end perf tests demonstrating p95 and p99 targets under 2x baseline QPS in a staging multi-region setup
Observability: per-tenant dashboard shows rerank latency by region, circuit-breaker state, and fallback counts
Feature flag gated rollout with canary percent and automatic rollback on increased error budget burn rate
Documentation: operator runbook for triaging rerank degradations and steps to tune circuit-breaker thresholds
testing_plan: Synthetic traffic k6 scenarios: steady, spiky, and KV-cache-miss heavy; validate latency and error rates
Chaos experiment: simulate primary-region GPU pool OOMs and verify circuit breaker and routing behavior
Tenant opt-in matrix: verify tenants with data residency disabled can fall back cross-region; others are restricted
A/B canary: enable feature for 1% of traffic and monitor error budget for 1 hour before ramping
rollout_plan: Feature gated behind runtime flag: rerank.resilient_routing
Stage 1 (canary): 1% traffic in staging-multi-region cluster for 24h
Stage 2 (ramp): 10% production traffic for 6h with SRE oncall monitoring
Stage 3: 50% for 24h if metrics stable, then global rollout with 3-day watch
Rollback: toggle runtime flag off and run emergency cache-warm job if rollback causes increased latency due to cold cache
metrics: fallback rate per minute (counts of model fallbacks and cache fallbacks)
circuit-breaker open time and trip count per minute
error budget burn rate (5xx and timeouts) for rerank endpoints
cross-region traffic percentage and added median latency due to failover
